annotations.title: Press release writer (AP style) with fact check

description: Press release writer (AP style) with fact check — Write a newswire-ready press release from the facts you give (text= required; optional company=, city=, date=YYYY-MM-DD, quote_from=Name, Title, about= company description, tone=, audience=). Returns headline, subheadline, AP-style dateline, lead, body paragraphs, quotes, boilerplate, key facts, missing info a journalist would ask for, and a full Markdown release ending with ###. Offline checks flag any number in the output that was not in your input (hallucination guard), hype words editors cut, a lead over 45 words, a headline over 100 characters and placeholders left to fill, with a score and grade. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
